events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect course code state and uncommitted diff
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git diff --stat cloud/src/course.ts; git diff cloud/src/course.ts | head -60; wc -l cloud/src/course.ts cloud/scripts/course/build.py; grep -n "drive\|Drive" cloud/src/course.ts cloud/scripts/course/build.py | head -20; git log --oneline -5 -- cloud/src/course.ts cloud/scripts/course/build.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check name default commit and push state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show 0e9ed0a4 --stat | tail -3; git show 0e9ed0a4 | grep '^[-+]' | grep -v '^+++\|^---'; grep -rn "pro_course_name" cloud/src | head; grep -n "Tantra Pro" workshop-plan/**/post.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; git log -1 --format=%H origin/main; git branch -r --contains 9d7f5e28 | head -2; git branch -r --contains 0e9ed0a4 | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read course header and settings storage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,20p cloud/src/course.ts; grep -n "export async function getSettings" -A12 cloud/src/settings.ts | head -20; grep -n "database_name\|bucket_name" cloud/wrangler.toml | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate wrangler config
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; ls wrangler* 2>/dev/null; grep -n "database_name" wrangler.* | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read live course name setting and recordings (read-only)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT key,value FROM settings WHERE key LIKE 'pro_%'; " 2>&1 | grep -v '^\s*$' | head -30; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT meeting_id, topic, start_time, duration FROM zoom_recordings ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -o '"meeting_id[^}]*' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read recordings and events rows (read-only)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT * FROM zoom_recordings LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | head -c 1200; echo; npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --json --command "SELECT meeting_id, event, count(*) n FROM zoom_events WHERE meeting_id IN ('87002851906','88135386601') GROUP BY 1,2" 2>&1 | head -c 600

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin auth used by probes and course routes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "admin/api/course\|ADMIN_TOKEN\|x-admin" cloud/scripts app/scripts --include=*.mjs --include=*.py --include=*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "course" cloud/src/index.ts | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read admin auth mechanism
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "async function isAdmin" -A10 cloud/src/*.ts | head -14; grep -rl "isAdmin\|admin_session\|ADMIN_KEY" app/scripts/*.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -3
